description:
Generates developer-oriented Google Consent Mode v2 banner integration code with configurable 'gtm_mode' ('v2_basic' strict tag-blocking vs 'v2_advanced' cookieless behavioral modeling with 'ads_data_redaction' and 'wait_for_update') and dynamic 'paperloo_consent_update' listener snippets across 'html', 'react', 'nextjs', and 'vue'.

When to use vs. related tools: Choose 'get_consent_banner_code' over 'get_cookie_banner_script' when building custom frontend apps (including Vue 3) or when explicitly selecting Basic vs. Advanced Google Consent Mode v2 behavior. Choose 'get_cookie_banner_script' for CMS embeds (WordPress, Webflow, Shopify). Choose 'get_gtm_container_setup' for full Google Tag Manager container '<head>'/'<body>' snippets.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must match a registered site in the active registry. Read-only operation.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success', 'siteId', 'site_name', 'framework', 'gtm_mode', 'embed_code', 'gcm_default_state', 'consent_update_listener', and 'instructions' (or 'error' on failure).

framework.description: Target JavaScript/HTML framework for generated code.

gtm_mode.description: 'v2_basic' withholds tag execution until consent; 'v2_advanced' initializes denied defaults with cookieless pings, wait_for_update, and ads_data_redaction.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL.

name: get_consent_banner_code

outputSchema.description: GCM v2 developer snippet with dynamic consent update listener.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

consent_update_listener.description: JavaScript listener snippet forwarding 'paperloo_consent_update' events to gtag('consent', 'update').

embed_code.description: Framework-specific GCM v2 initialization and Paperloo script snippet.

error.description: Error message if validation or site lookup fails.

gcm_default_state.description: GCM v2 default storage flags applied before visitor interaction.

gtm_mode.description: Google Consent Mode v2 integration mode.

instructions.description: Integration guidance for the selected GCM v2 mode.

site_name.description: Display name of the target site.

success.description: True if code generation succeeded; false otherwise.

title: Get Google Consent Mode v2 Developer Code
